description: This file defines a Go package 'cvd' that provides client-side abstractions for interacting with the 'cvd' command-line tool, including executing commands, parsing their output, managing credentials, and orchestrating virtual device instances and groups within the Android Cuttlefish environment.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a group of CVD instances, including the group name and a slice of Instance pointers.

classes.name: Instance
classes.description: Models an individual CVD instance, capturing its name, status, display info, directory, and device identifiers.

classes.name: Fleet
classes.description: Represents the output structure of the 'cvd fleet' command, containing a list of Group objects.

classes.name: FetchCredentials
classes.description: Interface for credential strategies used by cvd to access APIs; includes method AddToCmd for injection into command execution.

classes.name: FetchTokenFileCredentials
classes.description: Implements FetchCredentials, encapsulating OAuth2 token file credentials, with method to add necessary flags.

classes.name: FetchGceCredentials
classes.description: Implements FetchCredentials, indicating use of GCE metadata for credentials.

classes.name: Selector
classes.description: Defines criteria to select specific groups or instances for operations.

classes.name: CLI
classes.description: Encapsulates command execution for the 'cvd' CLI tool, providing methods to perform various operations such as load, create, start, stop, etc.

classes.name: CreateOptions
classes.description: Parameters for creating new CVD groups, including host path, product path, and instance numbers.

classes.name: StartOptions
classes.description: Options for starting CVD instances, including snapshot, kernel, initramfs, bootloader, and usage stats settings.

classes.name: FetchOpts
classes.description: Options for fetching images with default and system build identifiers and targets.

methods.name: AddToCmd
methods.description: Adds credential-specific flags to the command, implemented by credential types.

methods.name: buildCmd
methods.description: Constructs an exec.Cmd for a given binary and arguments within the CLI context.

methods.name: runCmd
methods.description: Runs the provided exec.Cmd, capturing output and logging, returning stdout or error.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Wraps runCmd with logging markers, executing commands with specified args.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a CVD group configuration from a specified config file and credentials.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new CVD group based on selector, creation options, and start options.

methods.name: toArgs
methods.description: Serializes CreateOptions or StartOptions into command-line arguments.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a specified CVD group with given start options.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops a specified CVD group.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a CVD group.

methods.name: Fleet
methods.description: Retrieves the current fleet state, listing all groups.

methods.name: BugReport
methods.description: Generates a bug report for a selected group, optionally including ADB bug report, saving to specified destination.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a specified CVD group.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended CVD group.

methods.name: TakeSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of a CVD group into a specified directory.

methods.name: PowerWash
methods.description: Performs a powerwash (factory reset) on a group.

methods.name: PowerBtn
methods.description: Simulates pressing the power button on a group.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Fetches system images and artifacts based on provided build IDs and targets, with credential support and post-processing.

methods.name: sliceItoa
methods.description: Converts a slice of uint32 to a slice of string representing their decimal values.

methods.name: createCredentialsFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file representing credentials, writes content, and returns the file handle.
